topics.title: Overview, 4 Editions & Zero-Dependency C++20 Architecture
topics.summary: Meet HelpStudio.exe, rshbuild.exe, RaggieSoftHelp.exe, and the 4 editions (Community == Architect parity).
topics.text:
overview, 4 editions & zero-dependency c++20 architecture 
  raggiesoft help studio ( v0.5.0 )  is a 100% native static  /mt  win32 c++20 help authoring workbench, legacy  .chm  and winhelp  .hlp / .cnt  decompiler, and sub-5ms  f1  context-routing runtime for windows 11  x64  and  arm64 . 
 four binaries in the box 
 
   helpstudio.exe  : 8-view tree-first visual ide with split markdown/html5 editing and pixel-accurate in-process  msftedit.dll   f1  preview. 
   rshbuild.exe  : headless ci/cd compiler, wcag 2.2 aa validator, legacy  .chm / .hlp  importer, and ai specification emitter. 
   raggiesofthelp.exe  : universal  < 650 kb  offline  f1  viewer supporting  .rshm.json  modules,  lzms  single-exe packs, and direct  .chm  &  .hlp / .cnt  rescue viewing. 
   rshtests.exe  : automated c++20 verification suite. 
 
 four named editions ( community == 100% architect parity ) 
     edition  scope & capabilities    
   community edition   free for hobbyists, solo creators, students, educators, non-profits, and open source —  100% technical parity with architect edition  and zero watermarks.  
   essentials edition   commercial tier 1 workstation: visual  .rshp  markdown/html5 authoring,  .rshm.json  module pack, standalone  <product>help.exe , and static html5 web portal.  
   developer edition   commercial tier 2: adds turnkey  .chm / .hhp  &  .hlp / .cnt / .hpj  importers, c++/c#/vb6/ts  f1  sdk emitters,  raggiescript  ( help.* ), and ci/cd rights.  
   architect edition   commercial tier 3: adds cross-suite federated search, conditional  oemtags  builds, and automated html5  vpat 2.5  conformance reports.

topics.title: Importing Legacy .CHM, .HHP, WinHelp .HLP & .CNT Files
topics.summary: Decompile raw ITSF/LZX .chm and 3F 5F 03 00 .hlp + .cnt archives and scrub Word MsoNormal HTML.
topics.text: importing legacy .chm, .hhp, winhelp .hlp & .cnt files millions of desktop, cad, laboratory, and industrial windows applications still rely on 1990s help formats that break on windows 11. raggiesoft help studio rescues both generations natively in pure c++20 without calling hh.exe , itss.dll , or retired winhlp32.exe . raw .chm ( itsf / lzx ) & .hhp decompiler extracts itsf v3 containers and decompresses lzx sliding-window streams directly—eliminating corporate \\fileserver\share unc and mark-of-the-web blank screens. parses .hhc table of contents and .hhk index

topics.title: Sub-5ms Named Pipe F1 Routing & Drop-In C++ / C# / VB6 SDKs
topics.summary: Wire WM_HELP, HtmlHelpCompatW, .NET WinForms/WPF, and Classic Visual Basic 6 forms to instant F1 help.
topics.text:
sub-5ms named pipe f1 routing & drop-in c++ / c# / vb6 sdks 
 every  .rshp  build emits ready-to-include sdk headers in  out/sdk/  so pressing  f1  on any dialog control wakes up  raggiesofthelp.exe  in under  5 milliseconds . 
 how named pipe  f1  ipc works 
 
 your application intercepts  f1  ( wm_help  in c++/win32/mfc,  helprequested  in .net winforms, or  keydown  in classic vb6). 
 the generated sdk shim writes a compact json message ( {"moduleid":"...","contextid":4160} ) to  \\.\pipe\raggiesoft.helpviewer.ipc.<user> . 
 if  raggiesofthelp.exe  is already open, it jumps to the exact topic and  #anchor  in  <5ms ; otherwise it launches  raggiesofthelp.exe  at that context id automatically. 
 
 one-line migration from  htmlhelpw  
  #include "sdk/raggiesofthelpsdk.hpp"

// inside win32 wndproc:
case wm_help:
    return rsh::sdk::handlewmhelp(lparam);

topics.title: WCAG 2.2 AA Validation, Static Web Portals & Auto-VPAT 2.5
topics.summary: Enforce contrast, alt text, and heading hierarchy at compile time and export HTML5 VPAT 2.5 reports.
topics.text:
wcag 2.2 aa validation, static web portals & auto-vpat 2.5 accessibility for end users is never paywalled across any edition of raggiesoft help studio . compile-time accessibility & integrity gates rsh015 : detects skipped heading levels (

directly to

). rsh020 : blocks unlabeled elements missing alt attributes. rsh025 : warns on unscrubbed word msonormal or color:black styles that break dark mode. rsh030 & rsh040 : catches broken topic links and duplicate numeric f1 context ids. rsh055 : verifies accentprimaryhex achieves >= 4.5:1 contrast against #ffffff button captions and >= 3.0:1 against #15203a dark mode cards. automated html5 vpat 2.5 conformance report pass --with-vpat to rshbuild.exe (or enable vpat 2.5 in helpstudio.exe ) to emit a standalone html5 accessibility conformance report (revised section 508 & wcag 2.2 level aa) covering both your desktop f1 viewer and static web documentation portal.
